c.h:
This guide describes the most effective methods to train the Divination skill. The experience rate estimates in this guide do not incorporate the use of any experience boosting items or bonus experience. Divination is a gathering skill which involves harvesting from wisps to create springs, from which energy and memories can be harvested. Energy can be used to create products such as portents and both memories and energy can be deposited into energy rifts to obtain Divination experience. While harvesting from springs, players have a chance of obtaining an enriched memory in place of a regular memory. Enriched memories award greater amounts of Divination experience when harvested or deposited at an energy rift. Energy rifts and groups of wisps can be found at wisp colonies.

Training the Divination skill typically involves gathering memories from wisps and depositing the memories at an energy rift. The amount of experience gained depends on the configuration used. When training, players should harvest enriched wisps and collect chronicle fragments whenever possible and ensure that they make a boon each time that they advance to a higher level wisp colony.

Players have a 1/25 chance of spawning a chronicle fragment which can be used to power rifts for Divination experience. Initially only the player that spawned the chronicle fragment will be able to see the fragment, before it becoming visible to all players if not caught. If the chronicle is caught within 6 seconds of spawning, the player will receive an enhanced chronicle fragment, which gives double the amount of experience and empowering percentage when used to empower a rift.

Chronicle fragments are used to empower an energy rift by using the rift's "Empower" right-click option. This grants Divination experience based on the player's Divination level and charges up the rift. Upon reaching 100% charge, the rift will spawn an enriched wisp and provide the Memory Overflow buff to all nearby players for 10 minutes.

If the player has completed the quest The World Wakes, they can alternatively deposit chronicle fragments at the altar within Guthix's Cave. This grants the same amount of Divination experience as using them to empower a rift. Offering 100 chronicle or enhanced chronicle fragments to the shrine will unlock the title.

Players can use the chronicle fragments, both regular and enhanced, to empower the energy rift. This will charge up the rift - by a base of 3.33% for regular and 6.66% for enhanced fragments. The power level of a rift can be checked by right-clicking it and selecting "Check power". Fully empowering a rift will spawn an Enriched version of the corresponding wisp, which guarantees enriched memories on each harvest, as well as give players a 10 minute Memory Overflow buff. As the empowerment percentage is tied to the rift and not the player, it is much more efficient to train on the designated community Divination training world.

At level 60, players can choose to activate the Abyssal Transit benefit from the Memorial to Guthix which will double the charges provided by each chronicle when empowering, leading to more frequent enriched wisp spawns.

Note that empowering a rift a second time while the previous enriched spring is still active will not spawn a second enriched wisp, thus players should always wait for the previous one to disappear before attempting to empower the rift again.

When training Divination, the mode of depositing memories at the rift can be configured via a right click menu. This offers the following options:

  • Experience, which deposits the memories for some Divination experience
  • Enhanced experience, which deposits both memories and energy for 25% more experience than the experience mode. If energy runs out while in this mode, it will automatically switch to experience mode.
  • Energy, which deposits memories and returns energy, granting a tiny amount of experience

Enhanced experience is the method to use for maximum experience per hour, however be aware of the cost - enhanced experience has an extremely high cost per experience point (69.42 gp coins per experience point for incandescent energy - see divine energy for all energy types). It should generally be avoided except for players with a very high time value - use the normal experience mode instead.

Boons are untradeable, single-use items created from divine energy. When a boon is used, it grants a permanent 10% base experience and energy boost when converting a particular type of memory. Boons can be made using energy of the same or tier below of energy corresponding to the memory tier that they affect. Boons are available for all types of divination spot except pale energy. Boons have no effect on the xp gained whilst Dungeoneering in Daemonheim.

Throughout the whole levelling process, it's recommended to use the dedicated community Divination training world when training Divination at energy rifts. Training on this world makes it easier to benefit from multiple players empowering rifts and interacting with wisps, causing more frequent enriched springs, higher uptime of the Memory Overflow boost, and longer wisps duration.

At level 1 Divination, players may harvest from pale wisps, which are located south-east of Draynor Village. With level 1-10 Divination players can obtain around 5,000 experience an hour from training at pale wisps using additional bought energy, requiring approximately 725 pale energy (costing 202,275 gp) per hour, or 4,000 experience an hour if not buying additional energy. As only 1,154 experience is required to reach level 10 Divination, players with no previous experience of the skill should achieve level 10 in approximately 19 minutes, using around 225 pale energy (costing 62,775 gp) if using bought energy. Players can easily hand in chronicles to May Stormbrewer while training at these levels, as she is located next to the pale wisp colony.

c.h: At level 10, players can move on to training at the flickering wisp colony, which is found east of the Falador lodestone. Around 10,000 experience an hour can be gained by training at flickering wisps if the player purchases additional energy, or 8,000 experience an hour without buying additional energy. This is the first location at which players may encounter enriched versions of a colony's wisps.

With at least level 20 Divination players can move to the bright wisp colony, which is found east of Varrock and the Varrock lodestone, south-west of the Varrock Dig Site, and north-west of the Archaeology Guild. When buying additional energy, players can gain around 14,000 experience an hour from training at bright wisps, or 12,000 experience an hour if not buying additional energy.

From level 30 players can train south of Seers' Village, just east of the Sorcerer's Tower, at the glowing wisp colony to gain approximately 19,000 experience an hour, if using additional purchased energy, or 17,500 experience an hour if not using additional energy.

Players with level 40-50 Divination can train at the sparkling wisp colony to gain around 23,000 experience an hour without purchasing additional energy, or 28,000 experience an hour if using additional energy. This colony is located just south-west of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and may be reached using the nearby fairy ring (code ).

From levels 50-60 Divination players should train at the gleaming wisp colony in the centre of Karamja jungle, north-east of the nature altar and Shilo Village. Without purchasing additional energy, players can gain around 27,000 experience an hour from training at this location. Around 33,000 experience an hour may be gained if buying additional energy.

At level 60 Divination players should start training at the vibrant wisp colony, just north-west of South Feldip Hills (accessible using a spirit tree right next to the colony, a ring of duelling to the Warforge Dig Site, or running west from the Oo'glog lodestone). Around 35,000 experience an hour may be gained by players who are not using additional purchased energy.

At level 65, players should start training at The Empty Throne Room, just southeast of the Varrock Dig Site. The player can generally expect experience rates of 65,000 per hour for transmuting empowered Senntisten crystals. In comparison, a player at level 65 could expect experience rates of 35,000 per hour harvesting and converting vibrant memories. It is recommended that the player uses this activity until level 75, because it offers an increase in XP/hour over other available methods at level 65-75.

This activity may have associated player-run services, such as Friends Chat channels.

At level 70 Divination, players can access the Hall of Memories located beneath the Memorial to Guthix. Given the substantial experience rates that can be attained at this activity with minimal effort, it is highly recommended that players do all further divination training here. Abilities such as Dive and Surge can be useful for quickly travelling between memories. It is highly recommended that the player speeds up their rate of gaining experience and memories by re-clicking instantly after every collection, a method known as 2-ticking. Additional experience can also be gained by collecting knowledge fragments and core fragments while training. Knowledge fragments will spawn once per hour and provide XP scaled to the player's level when captured, while core fragments can be placed on the plinths in the north for experience and to progress towards opening a core memory. It is recommended to place all core fragments on the community divination training world, 79, to contribute towards community AFK training.

Players can increase these experience rates by roughly 1.5x utilising 2-tick divination (for more information on 2-ticking, see tick manipulation). This is a much more intensive source of experience requiring significant clicking. Additionally, combining the 2-tick method with the elite skilling outfit and the energy-gathering scrimshaw can provide 400k+ XP/hr at 99 Divination. This involves joining a Friends Chat dedicating to world hopping to "pop" memory buds using six core memory fragments on the plinths in the Hall of Memories.

Players who wish for a less intensive training method can harvest the faded memories in the centre of the room, wait for player-run "core hunting" events where the memory bud can be harvested continuously, or may continue to train at the highest available regular wisps.

At level 70 Divination the player can start training at the lustrous wisp colony, located east of the Slayer Tower.

Players may choose to train here sooner beginning at level 70 if they wish to skip the Empty Throne Room method. Without purchasing any additional energy, and training worlds with many other players, a player can gain upwards of 43,000 experience per hour consistently.

After completion of the Fate of the Gods quest players can train using elder wisps, found within the Elder Halls, from level 75 to 80 Divination. At this location enriched wisps spawn in the corridors, rather than near the crater which is located at the centre of the area.

Players who are unable to access the Elder Halls can train using lustrous wisps until level 80 Divination. The lustrous wisp colony is found just east of the Slayer Tower. Without purchasing additional energy, players may earn around 54,000 experience an hour from training using elder wisps. Players who have purchased additional energy can gain around 66,000 experience an hour.

With level 80-85 Divination players can train at the brilliant wisp colony, just east of the Mage Training Arena. Players who are training without purchasing additional energy can gain around 60,000 experience an hour from training at brilliant wisps, while 73,000 experience an hour can be gained using extra energy.

Players who have at least one level 99 skill or who have completed all quests can build a brilliant wisp colony portal within the garden of the Max Guild in Prifddinas to teleport directly to the brilliant wisp colony. Alternatively, if fairy rings are unlocked, the fairy ring can be used to teleport directly north of the colony at the entrance of the Polypore Dungeon. For players with neither of the above, the closest teleport would be the Archaeology journal which conveniently fits in the pocket slot that is not needed by the skilling outfit.

With level 81 Divination, players with 89 Herblore can use the extreme divination potions to boost their Divination level to 95 and train at the incandescent wisp colony.

Given the relatively low cost of these potions relative to the increased experience rates, this can drastically reduce training time. See the level 95+ section below for details on experience rates at the incandescent wisp colony.

From level 85–90 Divination players should train on Dragontooth Island at the radiant wisp colony. Around 65,000 experience an hour can be gained by players who are training at radiant wisps without using additional bought energy. When using additional energy players can gain up to 79,000 experience an hour.

Players who have at least one level 99 skill or who have completed all quests can build a radiant wisp colony portal within the garden of the Max Guild in Prifddinas to teleport directly to the radiant wisp colony. Players who have the hoardstalker ring or the Dungeoneering Cape can also use that to teleport to the wisp colony.

Special agent penguins spawn here regularly, making this a good spot for money-making while training Divination.

At level 90 Divination players can train using luminous wisps to gain around 71,000 experience an hour without using bought energy or around 83,000 experience an hour using bought energy. The luminous wisp colony is located in the south of Sophanem, requiring partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper to enter the city walls.

Players who have at least one level 99 skill or who have completed all quests can build a luminous wisp colony portal within the garden of the Max Guild in Prifddinas to teleport directly to the luminous wisp colony.

Alternatively, at level 90 Divination, players can visit Goshima, Cyclosis, or The Islands That Once Were Turtles in The Arc and harvest positive or negative energy, with positive being found on Cyclosis and negative being found on Goshima. Both energies can be found together on The Islands That Once Were Turtles. These energies are only gathered, not deposited, and bringing one type of energy to a spring of the other type creates ancestral energy which can otherwise only be found on Uncharted Isles. Both of these energy springs offer the same experience per hour, which is around 68,000 experience per hour normally, but can be higher with the addition of boosting equipment mentioned at the top of this page. This also earns around 660 chimes per hour, which is important for those trying to progress in The Arc.

While positive energy gathering is fairly safe, gathering negative energy on Goshima can be dangerous as there is a wandering Malignant entity roaming around which deals damage and drains run energy and prayer, unless a player has completed the miniquest titled Final Destination.

At level 95 Divination, players can train at the incandescent wisp colony west of Castle Wars and Yanille and south of the Poison Waste. The community divination training world commonly has nearly constant enriched wisp spawns at this location. While converting memories to unenhanced experience around 290,000 experience can be attained per hour with the Divine Conversion power. Around 398,000 experience can be attained per hour with Divine Conversion while converting gathered energy into enhanced experience along with an energy-gathering scrimshaw. Around 500,000 experience can be gained per hour if converting energy to enhanced experience and buying additional energy. This uses roughly 9,000-10,000 bought incandescent energy per hour costing 163*9000 gp to 163*10000 gp in addition to consuming all the energy gathered in the hour while using an energy-gathering scrimshaw.

Players who have at least one level 99 skill or who have completed all quests can attune an incandescent wisp colony portal within the garden of the Max guild in Prifddinas to teleport directly to the incandescent wisp colony.

c.h:
At level 95 Divination, players who have access to Uncharted Isles in The Arc can train on ancestral energy. Players must find dead moai on the island which are leaking ancestral energy and collect it. The energy is collected but no memories are produced or deposited, meaning all the experience comes directly from the gathering. With this in mind, no energy must be purchased or gathered to increase the experience per hour. This method gives approximately 107,000 experience per hour.

The experience from harvesting ancestral energy can further be bolstered by completing contracts given by Sojobo (contracts) on Waiko or via a contract contact on an uncharted isle. Divination contracts for ancestral energy give up to about 35,000 experience when handed in, though they tend to average about 24,000 experience each. Players may complete up to 3 contracts daily, and may purchase upgrades from Boni for a maximum of 7 daily contracts. Handing in all 7 contracts with for an average of 24,000 experience each yields an extra 168,000 experience on top of the experience from harvesting the ancestral energy for the contracts. Doing contracts, however, requires chimes to be able to reroll contracts until satisfactory divination ones are assigned.

Use of energy-gathering scrimshaws or superior energy-gathering scrimshaws can be highly beneficial when completing these contracts, as they give the player a chance of doubling the amount of divine energy the player harvests while they are activated. Both scrimshaws require level 80 Divination to use. The inferior energy-gathering scrimshaw gives a 15% chance of harvesting double energy. The inferior scrimshaw is tradeable, costing 514,699 gp, and lasts for 3 hours or around 1,500 energy at level 99 Divination. The superior energy-gathering scrimshaw gives a 20% chance of harvesting double energy. The superior scrimshaw lasts for 4 hours but it is untradeable. Players who have level 90 Fletching can unlock the ability to make energy-gathering scrimshaws by purchasing the energy-gathering scrimshaw scroll from Boni on Waiko for 5,000 chimes and 5 taijitu. The superior scrimshaw can then be crafted from 2 ancient bones.

Using the Time-worn Memories and Ethereal Connection benefits from Memorial to Guthix, scroll of gathering, and 2-ticking colonies in dungeons can lead to competitive, if not the best Divination experience per hour. At Divination level 85+ it is suggested to collect lustrous, brilliant, and radiant wisps. Multiple players interacting with a wisp together will extend its duration and increase overall experience per hour. It is also worth upgrading the gathering effect of the ring of kinship as it increases gained resources. 2-ticking wisps requires the player to click the wisp as soon as an experience drop appears. While this is click intensive, it actually increases AFK time as more resources are collected and as a result the player spends more time depositing these at the energy rift in the main room of the dungeon.

For solo players with the above boosts, it is possible to achieve 350,000-500,000 Divination experience per hour depending on wisp generation and floor completion speed. For elite dungoneering teams capable of 5-10 minute large floors, rates can exceed 1,000,000 Divination experience per hour. This is an alternative to Guthixian Caches as it also rewards Dungoneering experience as you complete floors.

Players can gain Divination experience as a reward for participating in Guthixian Cache, a Distraction and Diversion. Guthixian Caches, requiring 35 Divination, are available after depositing a total of 800 memories, then right clicking the energy rift at any wisp colony. While it is not possible to check one's progress or enter a cache while dungeoneering, any memories deposited count towards this total.

While participating in a Guthixian Cache, players may earn points by taking a memory from any of the memory deposits found at the walls surrounding the area and depositing it into the unstable rift located at the centre of the room. Players should ensure that they avoid any active automata while carrying a memory, as automata will destroy any memories carried by players who come into contact with them. A player may also gain points if they transform into Cres by using the "transform" option on any of the Statues of Cres located in the four corners of the room and temporarily subdue automata. The player will be transformed into Cres for 60 seconds. After transforming out of the Cres form, players must wait 60 seconds before they can use a Statue of Cres to transform again.

A maximum of 100 points can be gained each time that a player participates in a Guthixian Cache. Players can gain between 4,700 and 36,700 experience, with level 35-99 Divination, if they obtain 100 points in a Guthixian Cache. The cache is also completable solo due to the unstable wisps available. Once gathered, throwable unstable memories can be crafted inside of the cache to create great large zones of distraction, preventing the automatons from smashing the carried memory whilst they are distracted.

Upon completing a cache, players (including ironmen) have a chance to receive a random part of the diviner's outfit they don't already own.

Players can get a large amount of Divination experience by gathering, charging and handing engrams as part of the Memorial to Guthix Distraction and Diversion. With each prestige level, players are able to collect and charge twelve engrams, albeit for an increased amount of memory strands and divine energy each time they do so. The charged engrams can then be handed to Orla Fairweather for Divination experience, scaling with the player's current Divination level. At level 99, the 12 engrams each grants 68,769 Divination experience for a total of 825,228 experience plus 40,512 for prestige, and 13 Guthixian butterflies, using 4,104 memory strands.

Alternatively, players who have already reached the first level of prestige can hand memory strands directly to Orla for Divination experience. Doing so only grants a small fraction of the experience they would normally receive by using the strands to charge engrams; turning in 4,104 strains would result in only 72,822 experience only (9% or 1/11 times difference) at prestige 3+ and level 99 Divination. As such, players wanting to achieve the most experience per memory strand should continue to collect, charge and hand engrams rather than turning in extra memory strands for experience, at the cost of extra divine energy.

c.t: Cleansing corrupt shards at the Gate of Elidinis
c.h:
The Gate of Elidinis requires completion of the Ode of the Devourer quest. Divination fragments (if the Elder outfit is not already owned) and memory strands will not be gathered. Urns and skillchompas do not work.

This focuses on cleansing the corrupt shards for Divination experience, which scales with the Divination level. The intensity ranges from moderate to high, as movement abilities such as Dive and Surge may be used to travel between shards. The aim is to cleanse all shards south of the barrier. There are multiple ways to do this but once this is done head north past the barrier to be killed by the Gate, which resets the battle (deaths are safe). Each cycle lasts around 2 minutes and 30 seconds, which comes to 285,000 experience per hour at 99.

Icthlarin's Aid method

Start by gathering some moonstone fragments from the moonstones and repair the conduits to at least 30% while waiting for the corrupt shards to fall down. Cleanse the leftmost shards first. Before the Gate reaches its next special attack (which will usually be at the beginning of the fourth shard), call upon Icthlarin's Aid with the extra action button. Once Icthlarin's barrier comes up, stand on the left side of the fifth shard which still allows the barrier to heal and protect from the massive attack while cleansing the shard. At the seventh shard, ignore the special attack and the feline akh that follows it. There should still be enough health left to finish the last shard, even if the attack is not dodged.

Food method

This requires less attention as the extra action button (Icthlarin's Aid) is not used, but some food will have to be eaten in order to cleanse all 8 shards. Repair the barrier to at least 60% before the shards spawn. Cleanse the shards in any desired order and stay above 25% health.

c.h: At Level 77 Divination and with partial completion of Heralds of Crimson, players gain access to the Divine Fall on Havenhythe and the Colossi Divination activity. This activity involves charging a Memory stone at the colossus remnants located at Divine Fall and then discharging it at one of several murals located across the island for large amounts of Divination experience and Remnant energy.
